---
name: Bug report
about: A reproducible problem with modeling, rendering, files, or installation
---

Describe the expected result and what happened instead.

Include the source revision or image pair, Linux/amd64 host details, NVIDIA GPU
and driver, and client name. Provide the smallest model and command sequence
that reproduces the problem. Include relevant redacted errors and whether the
scene or files changed after a timeout.

Do not include bearer values, download grants, private models, or credentials.
Report vulnerabilities through the process in SECURITY.md.
